description: The bar chart titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment" compares the runtime in seconds of different models on the SEconvo dataset. The vertical axis represents the runtime in seconds, ranging from 0 to 400, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists five models: Our Joint Framework, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude. The Our Joint Framework has a runtime of 77 seconds, represented by a green bar. ChatGPT has a runtime of 190 seconds, represented by a light blue bar. DeepSeek has the highest runtime at 365 seconds, also represented by a light blue bar. LLaMA has a runtime of 172 seconds, and Claude has a runtime of 243 seconds, both represented by light blue bars. The chart is used to illustrate the runtime performance of these models in a streaming environment.
